requirement:
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.

When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
rationale:
The code carries out every obligation in `requirements.definitions.authoring_inputs`, and each has a test. I found no gaps and no applicable `{fixme}`.

**1. Referenced definitions contribute their complete declaration with the phrase option.**
- `prepare` (`src/authoring/inputs.rs:63`) calls `definition_inputs` (`inputs.rs:814`) over the subject text and all contributed inputs.
- `terms::dependencies` and `direct_references` (`src/terms.rs:42` and `:58`) scan Rust comments, declaration bodies and other files for term references. Each resulting definition is read through `source_input` as a full definition input.
- Tests assert the `:::{definition}` fence and the `:phrase:` line (`src/authoring/mod.rs:1433`). `bundle_combines_direct_references_terms_and_current_existing_selectors` (`inputs.rs:870`) covers a term referenced by the subject. `mandatory_git_inputs_require_staging_declarations_sources_and_terms` (`inputs.rs:1023`) covers a term referenced from a contributed source comment.

**2. Transitive inclusion without duplicates or nontermination on cycles.**
- `close_dependencies` (`src/terms.rs:124`) uses a worklist with a `visited` set and a `BTreeSet` result, so each definition appears once and cycles terminate.
- `prepare` also skips inputs already in `mandatory`.
- The bundle test and the `mod.rs` test use mutually referencing `unit` and `value` definitions. They assert exactly two definition inputs, once each.

**3. Definitions from an additional read are supplied and recorded before a submission is accepted.**
- `read` and `ResultPages::deliver` (`src/authoring/tools.rs`, `src/authoring/pages.rs:114`) attach `additional_definitions` or `definitions_each` to item, requirements, definition and line-range reads. Definitions already recorded are filtered out.
- `converse` (`src/authoring/mod.rs:1223`) sends them in the tool result and queues them in `pending`. It then calls `record_inputs(&pending)` on the next successful response, before parsing any submission.
- `definitions_introduced_by_a_read_are_supplied_and_recorded_before_submission` checks all three points. The definition text is absent from the first request and present in the second. The recorded evidence holds the transitive set once each.
- `reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms` (`src/authoring/tools.rs:1126`) checks the item-read and line-range-read deliveries and their recording.

All the code that carries these obligations is reachable from the `{impl}` items `prepare` and `converse`. All three tests carry `{test}` references to the subject.

fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.
When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
:::{req} mandatory_inputs
The harness MUST construct each assessment's mandatory input set by combining
the contributions specified by the requirements applicable to that subject and
its inputs. A requirement that contributes inputs MUST cite this requirement and
define which sources it contributes and when. The harness MUST include every
applicable contribution, deduplicate identical selections, and report
unresolvable mandatory inputs before inference. The complete set MUST be supplied
in the initial model request.
Generated output under project-root `evidence/`, including symlink aliases, MUST
be omitted from mandatory inputs when the default exclusion applies. An explicit
workspace allow MUST permit those selections; an explicit disallow MUST abort
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.read_denial`.
